text.tspan: DAC_MCU — STM32H747 SMA RECEIVER / BIPOLAR CONVERTER
Two independent signal channels. Ordinary wires within blocks; named ports only at relay boundaries / shared reference.
01 CHANNEL A — SMA INPUT / BUFFER / BIPOLAR CONVERSION
Input contact: K101 (section 04). Output contact: K102 (section 05). Ports are only used across these functional blocks.
02 CHANNEL B — SMA INPUT / BUFFER / BIPOLAR CONVERSION
Input contact: K101 (section 04). Output contact: K102 (section 05). Ports are only used across these functional blocks.
03 MCU VREF+ / HALF-REFERENCE BUFFER / OP-AMP DECOUPLING
04 INPUT MUTE — K101 selects external SMA signals or VBIAS
05 OUTPUT MUTE — K102 selects converted signals or GND
Vout = (100k / 14k) * (Vin - MCU_VREF_PLUS / 2). Nominal 3.3V reference; 0.25V..3.05V input maps to about +/-10V.
Input and output enable are independent. MCU source / receiver share GND. High-impedance load only; no 50-ohm termination.
Op-amp power pins are shown on the A units. K101 / K102 coil drivers include flyback diodes and default-LOW pull-downs.
